verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI (cursor.com/cli, curl installer) and background/cloud agents that run 'on schedules or triggers' to build and fix software autonomously, which implies non-interactive/headless automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration, exit codes, or scripting examples for pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions example), documented headless flags/exit-code behavior, and independent confirmation of CLI use in automated pipelines.
